question.question: Can eight propagation layers and four dynamic relation-query layers retain full12 accuracy at lower cost?
question.deficiency: The final GPTrans head reads only the molecular node and self pair; the value of continuing all-atom propagation versus differentiable query readout is unmeasured.
alternatives: Dynamic relation queries recover useful computation
question.positive_decision: Nominate D only when upper paired95%CI for D-A <=1meV, point delta<=1meV and mature-pass training time saves >=15%; no automatic scale-up.
question.negative_decision: Retain truthful quality/cost evidence; no automatic successor, baseline substitution or scale-up.
